Tests archive extraction with custom security limits

```swift title="Swift"
import Xberg

let result = try await Xberg.extract("{\"kind\":\"uri\",\"uri\":\"https://example.com/archives/documents.zip\"}", "{\"security_limits\":{\"max_archive_size\":104857600,\"max_compression_ratio\":50,\"max_files_in_archive\":100}}")
debugPrint(result.results()[0].mimeType())
debugPrint(result.results()[0].content())
```
